evidence: The body checks a helper result, context selectors 0 and 0x20, a 16-bit field at input+0xef6, global bytes and selector 0x13, then returns a boolean. Caller f_70017120f0 consumes that result, but available evidence does not establish what predicate it represents; left unnamed (decompiled/main/main_0165.c:19479-19524; decompiled/main/main_0163.c:13986-13987).

Initializes the caller output through the helper path, resolves a value through a global context/table lookup, follows one of two selector-4 helper paths, compares the resulting float against 0.5, and stores the comparison result as a 32-bit boolean to the output pointer. No indexed callers were available (decompiled/main/main_0124.c:1340-1385).

Returns -2 when selector 0x13 is 8 or validation/index checks fail. Otherwise it asks f_700077ad10 to populate a 30-entry stack array, checks the requested index is at most 0x1d, and returns the indexed 32-bit entry. Its caller stores results from two index/mode calls into the same record (decompiled/main/main_0119.c:26588-26632; decompiled/main/main_0117.c:8489-8493).

Initializes the caller output to -1. On the valid lookup path it reads a 16-bit value from the resolved record at offset 0x54, obtains the nested-provider float for selector 0x16, adds that float to the value, converts the result to signed integer, and stores it to the output pointer. No indexed callers were available (decompiled/main/main_0124.c:27714-27756).

The exported guest entry immediately tail-calls its generated fb_ body. The body performs a long vector/table-driven numeric transformation, but its domain and result role are not established by the caller or the one known helper name; left unnamed (decompiled/main/main_0007.c:35677-35681, 35682-36018).
